posts.text: We locked in!! … and it actually worked. (sort of) This week, Mats Leis and I demoed “The Perfect Squat” — a computer vision system that tracks your lifts in real time. At two showcases. And honestly… we didn’t think people would care. We built it to solve a small problem we had for ourselves in the gym.
